column3: NASB follows the critical text (“Jesus,” without “Christ”); “brothers” is rendered “brethren,” and “do carefully consider” “consider.”
NASB renders “the one having built it” as “the builder of the house.”
NASB supplies “was faithful”; it includes “firm until the end,” which is in the Textus Receptus but not in the critical text.
“In the rebellion” is rendered “as when they provoked Me.”
NASB follows the critical text (“by testing”); it supplies “Me” and joins “forty years” to this verse.
NASB follows the critical text (“this generation”).
“A heart evil of unbelief” is rendered “an evil, unbelieving heart,” and “brothers” “brethren.”
“Each every day” is rendered “day after day”; NASB adds “still.”
“As the saying” is rendered “while it is said,” and “rebellion” “as when they provoked Me.”
“Rebelled” is rendered “provoked Him,” and “through Moses” “led by Moses”; NASB adds “Indeed.”
